xna-type.name: PassThroughProcessor
xna-type.summary: Provides an implementation of a no-operation processor that returns an unmodified copy of the input data.
xna-type.remarks: PassThroughProcessor is useful when the importer is already producing data in a game ready format. This can occur after importing textures from DDS files that have been formatted using an external tool, or when deserializing game logic data from XML using the intermediate XML importer.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the PassThroughProcessor class.

method.name: Process
method.summary: No-operation process that simply returns the input argument.

overload.summary: No-operation process that simply returns the input argument.
